training_population: original CHORD train+val only, survival_mask=True, exact V2-02 eligible modeling population
training_objective: 0.5*(PRE fractional-censor NLL + POST fractional-censor NLL), patient-balanced
performance_claim_policy: Final all-development fit is deployment-only; in-sample scores are not reported as validation evidence.
historical_test_policy: Original CHORD test is excluded from V2-07 fitting and is not reopened for selection/evaluation.
external_policy: No DFCI/VICC or other external outcomes are opened; external confirmation remains pending a genuinely new independent cohort.
inference_boundary: Prepared landmark tensors after frozen upstream R1 temporal/genomic preprocessing; raw-cohort intake remains governed by V2-06.
resume_policy: Epoch-level atomic training-state checkpoint; deterministic epoch seeding permits safe resume without changing the intended optimization schedule.
